step_a: Extract every nonzero same-color 4-connected object, tight-crop it, measure occupied area, and order the crops by descending area with canonical spatial tie breaks.
intermediate: The input-dependent ordered list of tight object crops, represented here by ordered colors, occupied areas, and source bounding boxes.
step_b: Center-pack the ordered crops from step A left-to-right with exactly one black separator column.
why_b_depends_on_a: The packer consumes the ordered crop list directly; replacing largest-first order with the spatial-order intermediate moves distinct shapes and colors to different output columns.
